From: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>
To: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2026 12:55:00 -0800
Subject: Fwd: Clarion - request for 25% concession + net45 / co-marketing

Team — forwarding Clarion’s ask. Quick summary and recommendation: 

Summary of ask from Clarion (external):
- 25% off list hosted API usage for first 12 months (implied blended rate $0.000675/token)
- Net45 payment terms (non-standard for this motion)
- $15k co-marketing credit and joint PR timing
- 12-month commitment with target >5M tokens/month after ramp

Why this matters:
- Strategic prospect in our core health vertical; referenceable pilot + press could open 3–4 similar mid-market deals in H1 2027
- Reasonable ARR commitment (~$120k annualized) and predictable consumption profile (prefix-surfaceable)

Risks / mitigations:
- Margin impact: 25% reduces unit margin substantially unless we preserve caching/batching profiles; recommend limiting concession to hosted API only (no other add-ons) and implementing monthly usage floors in contract
- Billing terms: net45 increases credit risk; suggest Net30 + ACH/credit card for first three months or require a purchase order + initial 30% prepay. Legal will want to see net45 justification.

Requested action:
- Mina / Marissa — asking for exec sanction to approve a 25% hosted API concession and to accept net45 only if procurement provides an approved PO and the finance team signs off on the credit lines. Also requesting authority to approve a $15k co-marketing credit tied to measurable deliverables.

I’ve attached the redlined SOW and proposed term sheet (Clarion_SOW_redline.docx).

Happy to jump on a 15-min call if you prefer.

—Nikhil
From: Mina Haddad <mina_haddad@redwood.com>
To: Nikhil Sharma <nikhil_sharma@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.com>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
Date: Fri, 13 Nov 2026 16:42:00 -0800
Subject: Re: Fwd: Clarion - request for 25% concession + net45 / co-marketing

Thanks for the context and the clear recommendation. I approve the one-time exception on the following conditions (please document in the SOW and term sheet):

1) Commercial concession: 25% off list hosted API unit price for months 1–12 only (renewal revert to standard list or new negotiated pricing).
2) Billing & credit: Clarion must provide a signed PO and agree to a 30% initial prepayment. Finance will evaluate credit for Net45; Net45 may be granted after 3 months of on-time payments and review.
3) Usage floor: Minimum monthly billed usage of 4M tokens during months 3–12; if usage falls below the floor, make-whole billing applies for the shortfall at list rates.
4) Co-marketing: $15k credit capped to PR spend and joint webinar activity; deliverables and timelines to be included as an addendum.
5) Legal & Risk: Legal to approve redlines; Sales to confirm that caching/ batching recommendations are configured to limit token spend inflation.

Mina Haddad
VP, Strategic Revenue
Redwood Inference

Cc: Sales Ops, Legal (please open a ticket for contract execution and update the HubSpot deal record with the approved concession and conditions).

Approved via email per our delegated authority. Formal sign-off recorded in HubSpot: https://hubspot.company/contacts/CLAR-2026-047
